question: Which education-related document, issued in 1854, laid the foundation for modern education in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wood's Despatch**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Wood's Despatch**, also known as the **Magna Carta of English Education in India**, was issued in **1854** by Sir Charles Wood, the President of the Board of Control of the East India Company. 
• It laid the foundation for the modern education system in India by introducing a structured and systematic approach to education. 
• The Despatch emphasized the establishment of **universities in Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras**, which were later set up in **1857**. 
• It proposed the creation of a hierarchy of schools: **primary, middle, and higher education institutions**, with a focus on **English as the medium of instruction for higher education**. 
• The Despatch encouraged the **promotion of vernacular languages** at the primary level to ensure wider accessibility and understanding among Indians.
